posts.author: mjshi
posts.body:
Introducing...
Autopause at Punctuation v1.0 (MV)
by mjshi- OK for use in all projects with credit
Get it here!
(
direct link
)
Automatically pauses your dialogue, briefly, at punctuation marks.
There's a
VX Ace version
, too.​
Introduction
You know, I bet your eyes paused for a moment at the comma in this sentence.
And I bet you paused, too (but longer) at that period in the sentence above.
What this script does is pause dialogue briefly at certain punctuation marks, mimicking natural speech.
Features
- Pauses dialogue when an appropriate punctuation mark appears. That's pretty much it.
Video Demo
- see the difference yourself!
Credit
mjshi
